rv.q: "Cygnus" is one of the most sophisticated small shows of the Chicago year so far and represents off-Loop theater otherwise firing on all cylinders.
And if you don't go home and reread your Edith Hamilton you might have missed too much, so you need to go see it again!
There are elements to Cygnus that don't quite come together logically.

cn.t: Stanton's world premiere weaves trauma and mythology into a powerful exploration of the male gaze and recovery, with critics praising its magical realism approach to Greek myth and complex mother-daughter dynamics.
